title: Password read through the legacy prompt (c)
description: The code reads a password with getpass, the legacy terminal prompt. Its buffer is static and limited, it does not restore terminal state on every error path, and it cannot read from a non-terminal input.
remediation: Read the secret on a descriptor you control with echo disabled, for example a termios read with echo disabled.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the call without inspecting terminal restoration.
